Class RecordStore

java.lang.Object
org.cobol4j.schema.RecordStore
public final class RecordStore extends Object
CRUD operations against a SQL table mapped from a COBOL Record definition.

Generates SQL (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SELECT) from the Record's field definitions, binding COBOL field values to JDBC parameters and reading result sets back into Record fields.
